# HingeConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("HingeConstraint")`

A joint free to rotate about one axis: a door, a lid, an elbow. The axis is the joint frame's own X, so pointing the attachment points the hinge.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LimitsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the range below applies. Off is a hinge that spins freely. |
| `LowerAngle` | `number` | `-180` | read/write | How far it may turn one way, in degrees. |
| `UpperAngle` | `number` | `180` | read/write | How far it may turn the other, in degrees. A lower above the upper is unlimited. |
